nome.message: Clean Image Saver – Save as PNG, JPG, WebP

descrizione.message: Save any image as PNG, JPG or WebP from the right-click menu. No data collected, no servers.

errore_blob.message: This image was generated by the page and cannot be downloaded again.

errore_permesso.message: Permission for the image's site is needed: without it the image cannot be downloaded.

errore_scarico.message: The site did not return the image (code $CODICE$).

errore_formato.message: Image format not supported (for example SVG).

opz_chiedi.message: Ask where to save each time

opz_chiedi_nota.message: When off, images go straight to your downloads folder.

opz_qualita_nota.message: Higher = better image but bigger file. PNG is always lossless.

opz_privacy.message: Clean Image Saver collects no data and uses no servers: images are downloaded from their own site, converted in your browser and saved only on your computer.
